description_sq:
Apartament 2+1+Post parkimi tek Bulevardi Ri!
Ofrojme per shitje apartament 2+1 me post parkimi ne nje nga rezidencat me cilesore te Bulevardit te Ri.
Zona e Bulevardit te Ri eshte nje nga zonat me dinamike dhe me zhvillim me te vrullshem ne Tirane, me projekte ambicioze ne proces zhvillimi fale rivitalizimit dhe infrastruktures se ofruar.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e peste banim te rezidences "Orbital 6", pjese e ndertimit te kompanise "Gener II".
Organizohet ne nje sallon te bollshem ndenje me ambjent gatimi,dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete, depo, korridor shperndares dhe ballkon
Bashke me apartamentin ofrohet dhe nje post parkimi ne cmim
Per me teper informacion me kontaktoni.
description_en: Apartment 2+1+Parking post at Bulevardi Ri! We offer for sale a 2+1 apartment with a parking space in one of the best residences on New Boulevard. The New Boulevard area is one of the most dynamic and rapidly developing areas in Tirana, with ambitious projects in the development process thanks to the revitalization and infrastructure provided. The apartment is located on the fifth residential floor of the residence "Orbital 6", part of the construction of the company "Gener II". It is organized in a spacious living room with kitchen area, two bedrooms, two toilets, storage room, distribution corridor and balcony. Together with the apartment, a parking space is offered for the price. For more information, contact me.
